name: Last Stand on Grand Ave.
title: Robin #72
desc:
Croc's got Robin right where he wants him: on the receiving end of a whole lotta pain! Will Robin become the lunch? And things only escalate for Tim Drake when his dad decides to come to the rescue.

Robin is held hostage by Killer Croc against the joint forces of the Penguin and the GCPD. Robin is rescued by Alfred (in disguise) during the gang war. After defeating Croc, Robin is forced to lie to his father about being stranded in Gotham. This results in Mr. Drake starting an all-out media war about finding his lost son in Gotham.
